about_the_game:
This Tis the Season Pack includes 13 Holiday Clothing Items, 5 Holiday Wigs, 6 Holiday Furniture Items, 6 Holiday Decoration Items, 1 Holiday Mount, and 2 Holiday Pets.

No chimney, no problem! A mailbox is all you need to receive these gifts! The Tis the Season Pack is filled with tons of festive items that will make your farm feel merry and bright this holiday season.

Pack includes:
  • Seasonal Furniture Set: Seasonal Chair, Seasonal Table, Seasonal Couch, Seasonal Wardrobe, Seasonal Bed, and Seasonal Rug
  • Seasonal Decoration Set: Holly End Table, Jolly End Table, Wreath Lamp, Giant Snowglobe, Flying Reindeer, and Standing Reindeer
  • Seasonal Outfit Set: Beanie Wig, Ugly Sweater Dress, Trench Coat, Wool Skirt, Holly Buns Wig, Baker Dress, Seasonal Boots, Seasonal Dress, Long Johns, and Seasonal Gloves
  • Reindeer Outfit Set including: Reindeer Wig, Reindeer Overall Top, and Reindeer Overall Pants
  • Elvish Outfit Set: Elvish Twintails Wig, Elvish Bob Wig, Mini Wings Set, Top Elf Coat, and Top Elf Pants
  • Polar Bear Mount
  • Joe Snow, the Snowman Pet
  • Mistletoe, the Elf Pet
